title.rendered: Nebula Trust Bank Selects LAZ Parking to Manage Mystic Parking Lots

content.rendered:
Nebula Trust Bank recently signed a contract with LAZ Parking to manage the two parking lots located at their downtown Mystic location to improve the parking and overall experience for customers.

“Mystic is a major tourist destination, home to the Mystic Aquarium, the Mystic Seaport and amazing places to explore, dine and shop”, said Lori Dufficy, EVP, Chief Experience & Engagement Officer at Nebula Trust Bank. “And how fortunate we are to be able to have a historic branch building situated in the heart of this quintessential town, bustling with tourists and members of our local community throughout the year.” 

LAZ Parking will manage the two parking lots beginning in May ensuring Bank customers will have ample complimentary parking while conducting their bank business. When the bank is closed, patrons of downtown Mystic businesses will be able to park in the bank owned lots using the LAZ Text-to-Park technology, a quick, convenient cashless parking system using text messaging. “As a leader, we are committed to doing our part to help our communities thrive, said Lori Dufficy, which is why we’re inviting downtown Mystic visitors to use our lots after hours and by donating profits from parking fees to the Greater Mystic Chamber of Commerce to be used in a collaborative way with the Mystic Downtown Merchants Association for events and initiatives”.  

About the Greater Mystic Chamber of Commerce

The Greater Mystic Chamber of Commerce serves as the business voice for Groton, Stonington and Mystic. We sponsor and facilitate community events, promote local business and the regional tourism industry, are a resource for small business owners, provide opportunities to get involved with the community, and are an advocate for the government of our towns.

About the Downtown Mystic Merchants Association

Established in 2013, the Downtown Mystic Merchants is a non-profit initiative aimed at promoting Historic Downtown Mystic economically, culturally and aesthetically for the merchants, residents and visitors of our Historic Downtown. The mission of the Downtown Mystic Merchants Association is to enhance the experiences of shopping, eating, and simply strolling through our historic riverfront community.

About LAZ Parking 

LAZ Parking is the largest and fastest-growing privately owned parking operator in the United States and a pioneer in digital parking technology. Founded in Hartford, CT, in 1981, with four decades of experience providing best-in-class parking management and transportation services, LAZ operates over 1.3 million parking spaces across the country in over 3,450 locations in 38 states and 454 cities. Over the past decade, LAZ has led the industry with business intelligence, remote monitoring, eCommerce solutions, and most recently launched its Proximity On-Demand Services – “LAZ PODS”. Leveraging their national real estate parking network through connected tech enabled solutions, LAZ PODS includes EV charging, micro warehousing, last mile logistics, and ghost kitchens. LAZ works across various industries, including hospitality, commercial, healthcare, airports, transportation, universities, government, retail, events, residentials, and shuttle services. LAZ is a people first, conscious capitalist company that believes in elevating humanity through business. Additional information can be found at www.lazparking.com.
